People: Jacob Lennep (author, Wikidata Q675676), died 1868; Willem Jacobszoon Hofdijk (author, Wikidata Q1464893), died 1888. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Lennep, J. van (Jacob), 1802-1868; Hofdijk, W. J. (Willem Jacobszoon), 1816-1888") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Merkwaardige kasteelen in Nederland, G.W. Tielkemeijer, 1854, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/merkwaardigekas02hofdgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 77%, 54%, 73% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Jacob Lennep, Willem Jacobszoon Hofdijk, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
